title: 국방정보본부령 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Duties of Head, etc.)
(1) The Head shall, under the direction of the Minister of National Defense, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Defense Intelligence Headquarters and command and supervise units subordinated or attached thereto. [Amended on July 1, 2011.]
(2) The Head shall support intelligence affairs necessary for the Joint Chiefs of Staff to perform its military command duties. [Amended on July 1, 2011, and April 7, 2026.]
(3) Where the Head is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances, the most senior among the heads of staff divisions established within the Intelligence Headquarters pursuant to Article 4 (1) shall act on behalf of the Head. [Amended on December 30, 2009, and July 1, 2011.]
